svg.title: The scales tip at the gate
svg.desc: Editorial illustration for Nov. 22, 2026. From inside a darkened airport terminal at sunset, holiday travelers with rolling suitcases wait by a tall window and a departures board with blank amber rows. Outside, an unbranded airliner is parked at the jet bridge, and ramp workers in safety vests check a clipboard by its nose beside a loaded baggage cart. A huge, symbolic balance beam in the sky tips off-level, with an airliner on one pan and suitcases on the other. It stands for the failure of Delta's automated weight-and-balance system, which delayed more than 1,600 Delta flights nationwide as Thanksgiving travel began.
